name: 個人とワークスペースを分けた設定メニュー
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: Japanese Lighthouse catalog design candidate LH07-0104 個人とワークスペースを分けた設定メニュー.
Reference hierarchy: ORIGINAL source image(s) control icon glyph geometry, proportions, optical/stroke weight, alignment, spacing and fine control anatomy. Our saved FigCraft mock is secondary for Japanese content and overall layout; do not copy its rough substitute icons or omissions. Official Lighthouse white/forest-green/slate design and locked Japanese typography remain binding.
Input images: Image 1: original-source-reference. Image 2: secondary-component-preview. Image 3: approved-style-reference. The final approved bus style image controls only surface/gradient craft, never content or unrelated icons.
Render one Japanese account-and-workspace settings menu as a flat, pure-white, vertical UI component, about 360 logical pixels wide by 700 pixels high. Aim for a comfortable middle density: clear scan paths and touch room, with no oversized blank gaps or large presentation margins. Use a 40px pale-mint identity circle beside the first header; set its two text lines to the exact Meiryo roles in the existing mock. Follow with four account rows, a thin divider, a second 40px pale-mint circle and workspace heading, then seven workspace rows. Make each row about 50px high with a 20px source-shaped outline icon, consistent 24px side inset, and vertically centered text. Use subtle gaps around the divider and section header. Keep rows comfortably separated; do not compress them into small 36px controls. Use slate #526173 icons, primary #1D1D1D text, supporting #6E6E6E, divider #DCE5DF, and pale mint #D1FAE5 only for the existing avatar placeholders. Preserve the exact typography: Meiryo Bold 14px/24px for ライトハウスの利用者 and 個人のワークスペース; Meiryo Regular 12px/16px for 登録済みのアカウント; Meiryo Regular 14px/24px for every row. Include exactly these strings in this order and add no text: ライトハウスの利用者; 登録済みのアカウント; アカウント; ログインとセキュリティ; メッセージの設定; プライバシー設定; 個人のワークスペース; メンバーを招待; 契約内容; 一括ログインと利用設定; 利用状況の報告; チーム; 購入の履歴; ドメイン. Recreate original icon geometry: person inside a circle; closed padlock; envelope with diagonal flap; closed padlock; two-person outline with plus; circular currency mark with a return arrow; cloud with provisioning/key detail; simple bar chart; four-square team grid; shopping cart with two wheels; and outlined globe with latitude/longitude. Use consistent modest stroke weights. Keep the menu open and flat with no outer card, no shadows, no gradient, no chevrons, no phone/status/navigation chrome, no watermark, and no decorative background. Preserve the source row order and Japanese preview's clear personal-versus-workspace grouping.
Official constraints: pure #FFFFFF outer canvas; Do not invent an outer card around a flat component. Only existing card surfaces use rounded corners, fine neutral outlines and soft downward shadows; flat headings, lists and settings stay flat white. Primary actions use smooth #174C36 → #1F6444 → #2D8F5E gradient with legible white glyphs/labels and restrained edge light. Ordinary supporting icons #526173 unless a specifically justified group/state overrides. No broad mint, decorative multicolored icons, excessive gloss or invented data/features. Preserve exact Japanese text and existing Meiryo typography, weights, line heights and wrapping. Orthographic clean UI render, no phone/environment, no watermark.
Accent decision: Preserve the Japanese mock's blank pale-mint identity circles as placeholders, with no initials. Use restrained slate icons and neutral separators from the Lighthouse system. Source imagery controls glyph geometry; do not import its yellow avatar or phone chrome.
LATEST DIRECT OWNER DENSITY CORRECTION, 2026-10-18: previous candidates were too big and too spacious. This overrides earlier source-spacing and presentation-enlargement instructions. Use compact ordinary UI proportions, content-driven control widths, restrained small radii, tight but readable padding, and little outer presentation whitespace. Preserve exact established Japanese font roles; do not shrink text to manufacture density. Preserve original icon geometry, strokes, states and artwork. Avoid stretching a small standalone utility control across an entire screen. Use the owner-corrected180x28 three-segment control as a density reference only, not a size to force onto unrelated components. Output image pixels are inspection resolution, never intended application CSS size.
reviewNotes: Candidate-only; reviewed at 360x699: all 14 Japanese strings present, 11 source-shaped icons, balanced group spacing, readable rows. No native or application acceptance claimed.
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
